strings.cfg_achievements__syncpaststats_help: When a character that has not used cheats loads, copy the stats the game recorded while achievements were not tracked into the achievement table. Characters that used cheats are never copied unless Hex allows it. Disabled while AchievementSync is installed. Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_achievements__resynckey_help: Key that rechecks your saved game statistics and grants any MeadWorks achievements already earned. Unassigned by default. Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_authority__vanillaservertimeoutsecon: Seconds a client waits for the server's Crucible Hello before treating the server as vanilla (cheats locked, required products off). Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_network__peerclasshandshake_help: Checks MeadWorks versions when a player joins: the server turns away clients missing a required MeadWorks mod or running a different major.minor version, and a client turns off required mods the server lacks. On by default; turn it off only to diagnose join problems. Restart the game after changing this setting. Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_logging__level_help: MeadWorks log level: Quiet (errors and warnings), Normal, Verbose or Debug. Also: console 'meadworks log <level> [product]'. Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_logging__productoverrides_help: Per-product levels, for example 'Wildroot=Debug,Burrow=Normal'. Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_logging__repeatwindowseconds_help: Identical lines inside this window are written once and counted; 0 writes every line. Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_logging__consolefilterenabled_help: Filter the BepInEx console for all installed mods by the rules below. Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_logging__consolefilterrules_help: Per-source console levels: 'Source=All|Info|Warning|Error|None', separated by ';'. '*' sets the level for unlisted sources. Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_logging__consolefilterappliestodiskl: Apply Console Filter to Log File
Also apply the console filter rules to BepInEx's LogOutput.log. Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_logging__showallconsolemessages_help: Show every message on the BepInEx console. By default Crucible hides a short, exact list of known-harmless vanilla and Unity messages (world-generation hints, missing audio or video shaders on a dedicated server and similar); LogOutput.log always keeps everything. Crucible owns this local installation setting.
strings.cfg_mischief__listedplayers_help: Platform user IDs granted Listed cheat categories, separated by commas (for example Steam_76561198000000000; a bare number means a Steam ID, as in adminlist.txt). Crucible owns this server setting; its value applies to joining clients.
strings.cfg_skills__experiencemultiplier_help: Multiplies experience in every MeadWorks custom skill (products' own skills, not the game's). The server's value applies in multiplayer. Crucible owns this server setting; its value applies to joining clients.
strings.cfg_mischief__personal_help: Who may use Personal cheats on this server: Nobody, Admins, Listed (admins and Listed Players) or Everyone. Single player and the host always may. Personal: affects only the user (god mode, speed, size). Crucible owns this server setting; its value applies to joining clients.
strings.cfg_mischief__economy_help: Who may use Economy cheats on this server: Nobody, Admins, Listed (admins and Listed Players) or Everyone. Single player and the host always may. Economy: creates or saves materials (spawning, craft speed, loot multipliers, free build). Crucible owns this server setting; its value applies to joining clients.
strings.cfg_mischief__world_help: Who may use World cheats on this server: Nobody, Admins, Listed (admins and Listed Players) or Everyone. Single player and the host always may. World: changes the shared world (weather, unrestricted growth). Crucible owns this server setting; its value applies to joining clients.
strings.cfg_mischief__information_help: Who may use Information cheats on this server: Nobody, Admins, Listed (admins and Listed Players) or Everyone. Single player and the host always may. Information: reveals what is hidden (ESP, map reveal, points of interest). Crucible owns this server setting; its value applies to joining clients.
strings.cfg_mischief__travel_help: Who may use Travel cheats on this server: Nobody, Admins, Listed (admins and Listed Players) or Everyone. Single player and the host always may. Travel: moves players (teleport, portals). Crucible owns this server setting; its value applies to joining clients.
strings.cfg_mischief__progress_help: Who may use Progress cheats on this server: Nobody, Admins, Listed (admins and Listed Players) or Everyone. Single player and the host always may. Progress: skills, boss powers, achievements, guaranteed upgrades. Crucible owns this server setting; its value applies to joining clients.
strings.cfg_look__styled_panels_help: The brown framed look of MeadWorks panels, their cells and buttons. Off: the game's wood. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_look__panel_theme_help: Timber: shared warm wallpaper with softly chopped, beveled wood edges. Brown: the original brown artwork. Styled Panels off restores the game's panels. Cosmetic, local to this player. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_look__timber_border_width_help: How thick the wooden edge of MeadWorks panels is. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_look__timber_border_jaggedness_help: How roughly the wooden edge of MeadWorks panels is cut. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_look__night_shade_help: How dark MeadWorks panels get at night, as the game's own wooden panels darken with the light around you (dark weather shades them too). 1 keeps them as bright as day; 0.65 at midnight in clear weather. Gray only, never the weather's color. Cells never change. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_look__theme_game_panels_help: Dress the game's own wood panels (crafting, character dialogs, settings) in the Timber look. Auto: when a MeadWorks product that lays out the inventory asks for it. Always or Never override. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_look__meadworks_map_frames_help: Draw MeadWorks wood-and-bronze frames over the game's minimap and large map. The map itself (terrain, pins, fog) is the game's own and stays untouched. Off: the game's maps exactly as they were. Cosmetic, local to this player. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_look__meadworks_screen_layout_help: Lay the inventory screen out in named regions: the grid at the top left, the equipment panel beside it, the character header and the crafting panel in a column at the right, and a dock for product panels under the equipment panel. Off: the game's own placement. Local to this player. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_general__meadworks_menu_key_help: Opens the MeadWorks menu (the window list of Esc > MeadWorks) from anywhere in game, except while chat, the console or a text field has the keys. Empty: no key; Esc > MeadWorks still works. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_notices__stacked_notices_help: Show MeadWorks notices in a stack. Off uses the game's own message. Local to this player, drawn by Crucible UI, and the server does not override it. Takes effect at once. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_notices__position_help: Corner of the screen for the MeadWorks notice stack: TopLeft, TopRight, BottomLeft or BottomRight. The stack stays clear of the compass and the Active effects row. Local to this player. Takes effect at once. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_notices__duration_help: How long each MeadWorks notice stays, in seconds. The same notice again restarts this time and raises its count. Local to this player. Applies to the next notice. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
strings.cfg_notices__maximum_visible_help: How many MeadWorks notices show at once. The newest sits at the top. Further notices wait until a space opens. Local to this player. Takes effect at once. Crucible.UI owns this local player setting.
